escalation_note: This is the one image-faced (no text layer) scan in the chunk. Every amount on both schedules was re-read in 600 dpi tight column-stack crops (3 stacks on p2, 3 on p3), the p2 date column was re-read in 2 further 600 dpi stacks to settle the 2/13/27 year digit, and 2 empty control crops were rendered. Every figure read identically to the 200 dpi full-page read, and -- the decisive check per the Rhodes rule -- the row sets sum to the printed totals EXACTLY on both sides, so arithmetic and glyph agree; no value rests on resolution alone.
notes: OFFICE CONFIRMED AT THE PAGE: index.csv says 'County Attorney'; the cover's handwritten Office line reads 'County Attorney' (hand-printed, legible) -- agrees, in scope. DATES: the chunk file says 2026-03-05; the cover, Schedule A and the Summary page all read '3/5/26' and the clerk's received stamp reads '2026 MAR 5 PM 4:5x' -- AGREES. But Schedule B (p3) carries 'Date of Report 3/6/26' -- ONE DAY LATER than its own cover and the other three pages; the filer's inconsistency, recorded, not reconciled. REPORT TYPE: none of the three printed radios is marked; the filer hand-wrote 'Special' beside 'Type of Report' and, in the right-hand block, '3 Business days before CCCC GOP submits names'. STRUCK TOTALS: on BOTH schedules the typed grid's own bottom-row grand total is crossed out by hand, yet the identical figure is re-entered by hand in the form's 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total ... in this report' lines and again in the Summary boxes -- so the strike is a presentation edit, not a retraction; the value is corroborated four ways and is used as the anchor. FILING SHAPE: both schedules are a TYPED, fully ruled grid (a spreadsheet print) laid inside the county form, with an EXTRA unlabelled narrow column between Address/Purpose and Amount that the filer used on Schedule A to write 'Loan'. That column is NOT an in-kind column and the form has none, so in_kind is false on every row. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN passed on both pages: 20 dates / 20 names / 20 amounts on p2 and 21 dates / 21 vendors / 21 purposes / 21 amounts on p3, each in its own ruled cell, no date-shaped content in a name cell or vice versa. Donor and candidate street addresses printed in the clear were discarded at read time (city/state only); the candidate's home address, phone and email on the cover likewise discarded. CALIBRATION-SPECIMEN CANDIDATE: the struck-through-but-corroborated grid total is a clean specimen of 'a crossed-out figure that is nonetheless the right anchor'.
